skill.name: outlook-automation
skill.description: Guides Outlook email, calendar, contact, folder, and attachment workflows through Rube MCP and Microsoft Outlook tools.
skill.summary: Automate Outlook workflows through Rube MCP for email search, calendar review, contacts, folders, and attachments.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, and examples. I confirmed a low network dependency on the external Rube MCP endpoint and added a medium privacy finding for third-party Outlook OAuth and broad Outlook data access. No prompt injection attempt or malicious instruction was found.

remediation.suggestion: Document the Rube MCP data flow, Microsoft OAuth scopes, retention behavior, and account revocation steps before publication.
Require explicit user confirmation before downloading attachments and clearly state where downloaded files are stored.
Explain that the skill requires trust in the Rube MCP endpoint and advise users to review service terms before connecting Outlook.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Outlook connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `outlook`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `OUTLOOK_SEARCH_MESSAGES` - Search with KQL syntax across all folders [Required]
- `query`: KQL search string (from:, to:, subject:, received:, hasattachment:)
- `message_id`: Message ID (use hitId from search results)
1. `OUTLOOK_LIST_MAIL_FOLDERS` - List mail folders to get folder IDs [Prerequisite]
- `filter`: OData filter (e.g., `isRead eq false and importance eq 'high'`)
2. `OUTLOOK_GET_CALENDAR_VIEW` - Get events in a time window [Optional]
- Recurring events need `expand_recurring_events=true` to see individual occurrences
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Use hitId from search results as message_id for downstream calls, not resource.id

content.value_statement: Outlook workflows can take time when users must search, triage, and inspect items manually. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP Outlook tools.
actual_capabilities: Search Outlook messages across folders with KQL queries.
Query messages inside a single mail folder with OData filters.
List, inspect, and search Outlook calendar events.
List and create Outlook contacts and contact folders.
List mail folders, child folders, and create new mail folders.
List and download Outlook message attachments through supported tools.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Outlook connection.
Some search features require Microsoft 365 or Enterprise accounts.
Personal Outlook accounts may have limited API access.
Current Rube tool schemas must be checked before each workflow.

use_cases.title: Find Important Mail
use_cases.description: Search a mailbox for sender, subject, date, or attachment criteria, then inspect selected messages.

use_cases.title: Review Calendar Availability
use_cases.description: List events, get calendar views, and check schedules before planning meetings.

use_cases.title: Maintain Contact and Folder Records
use_cases.description: Create contacts, organize mail folders, and keep Outlook information easier to manage.

prompt_templates.title: Search Recent Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Outlook mailbox for unread high importance messages from the last seven days. Show sender, subject, date, and whether attachments exist.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Message Attachments
prompt_templates.prompt: Find messages about invoices from this month, open the most relevant results, and list any real document attachments without downloading them yet.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Calendar Time
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Outlook calendar for the next three business days and summarize open blocks longer than 45 minutes in my timezone.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Mail and Contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: List my top-level Outlook mail folders, find project messages with attachments, and propose a folder and contact cleanup plan before making changes.

output_examples.input: Search for unread high importance messages from this week.
output: Found five matching messages in the Inbox.
Three messages are from internal senders and two include attachments.
The newest message asks for approval by Thursday.

output_examples.input: Review my calendar availability tomorrow afternoon.
output_examples.output: You have two open blocks tomorrow afternoon: 1:00 PM to 2:30 PM and 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM. One tentative event may reduce the first block.

output_examples.input: List folders and suggest where to file vendor invoices.
output_examples.output: The mailbox has Inbox, Archive, Finance, and Vendors folders. Vendor invoice messages fit best under Finance or a new Finance/Vendor Invoices folder.

best_practices: Search Rube tools first so parameter names match the current schema.
Confirm account connection status before running Outlook workflows.
Ask before downloading attachments or creating contacts and folders.
anti_patterns: Do not assume personal Outlook accounts support every search workflow.
Do not use calendar fields in email queries or email fields in calendar queries.
Do not use folder display names when a custom folder ID is required.

faq.question: Does this skill require Rube MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill depends on Rube MCP and its Outlook toolkit.

faq.question: Can it work with personal Outlook accounts?
faq.answer: Some operations may work, but the skill notes that personal accounts have limited API access.

faq.question: Can it download attachments?
faq.answer: Yes, when the Outlook attachment tool is available and the user approves the action.

faq.question: Can it create contacts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents Outlook tools for creating contacts and contact folders.

faq.question: Why should tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change, so the current schema should be checked before each workflow.

faq.question: Does it store Outlook data?
faq.answer: The skill file does not describe storage. Users should review Rube and Microsoft data handling terms before connecting accounts.
